environment: HolmesGPT 0.43.0 on Windows, local Magpie workbuddy/glm-5.3-flash, Kubernetes v1.36.4 in VMware lab isolated namespace

model_behavior: Despite being asked not to propose changes, the model included remediation suggestions in text. It did not execute changes; investigation tools and Kubernetes permissions remained read-only.
limitations: Each case is a synthetic investigation after iteration; not a statistical accuracy or time-saving measurement. T1 used the delivered handoff script; T3 used an equivalent temporary hook. Linux native Holmes and GitHub Actions remain unverified.
